prompt:
INPUT: attach this book's beginning form card image (her closed state). If a second image fits, add her first approved form image for the face.

BOOK: «허생전» by 박지원. comedy and satire · 17세기 효종 무렵의 조선(18세기 작) · 한양 남산 묵적골 → 안성 → 제주 → 빈 섬. Source scope: "『열하일기』 「옥갑야화」에 실린 허생 이야기 전체".

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

Design notes in quotes may be written in Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

OUTPUT: the OPEN state of the attached image — the climactic scene of this stage. Keep her face, hair, body, costume, camera, framing and subject scale. Change the world around her into this scene: "비 새는 남산골 오두막, 쌓인 책 더미와 빈 쌀독". She is the only person; the scene is carried by objects, environment, light, weather or a looming non-human presence. The pair must read as the same picture before and after the scene opens.

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

NOTE: Use the attached corrected beginning portrait as the exact fixed foreground. Preserve her face, expression, updo, hat, costume, body proportions, full-body position and camera framing. Especially keep BOTH ARMS exactly as corrected: her own right hand on image left holds the hat strap; her own left arm on image right is visibly connected from its shoulder through the sleeve, elbow and wrist to an empty relaxed hand beside the upper thigh. Do not hide, remove, reposition or duplicate either arm or hand. Change only the surrounding world to the beginning open scene: a poor Joseon hut below Namsan with rain leaking through its roof, piles of unlettered old books in the background and an empty rice jar. One woman only. The books remain background objects, never in her hands. Keep her unchanged and make the atmospheric scene surround her.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: keep both hands as in the attached image.
